kanaMaster.title: Kana Master
kanaMaster.description: Kana Master is an iOS application designed for learning Katakana and Hiragana. It includes various tests and practical exercises that help in learning and memorizing Japanese characters. The app also offers audio training for correct pronunciation and demonstrates how to properly draw each character.
